evals.name: delivery-sequence
evals.prompt: Use delivery-flow to deliver a small fix.
evals.expected_output: Runs every phase through verified PR and babysit, stopping on unmet prerequisites or failed checks.
assertions: Runs brainstorm, spec and approval, ledger plan and approval, real-data execution, delivery and babysit in order
Requires authenticated GitHub and a non-default branch before delivery writes
Does not claim completion without observing it

evals.name: standalone-brainstorm
evals.prompt: Brainstorm a small repository change.
evals.expected_output: Uses the appropriate triage, posts a capsule and stops before implementation.
assertions: Uses repository evidence and compares material alternatives when needed
Posts outcome, defaults, evidence, risk and handoff
Does not edit code or start delivery

evals.name: docs-route-failure
evals.prompt: Sync documentation for this branch, but no configured worker tuple is ready.
evals.expected_output: Reports routing failure without launching or attesting a worker.
assertions: Inspects the committed diff and checks worker readiness
Starts no worker and writes no review state when no suitable route exists

evals.name: structural-search
evals.prompt: Find calls to console.log across the JavaScript source.
evals.expected_output: Uses an ast-grep structural pattern before text search.
assertions: Uses ast-grep with a language and a call-shaped pattern
Does not use a text search as the first structural search

evals.name: semantic-commit
evals.prompt: Prepare a commit message for fixing the CLI crash.
evals.expected_output: Provides a scoped Conventional Commit and a reason in an Intent trailer.
assertions: Uses a lowercase imperative subject within 72 characters
Includes an Intent trailer explaining why
Does not bypass the semantic-git rule

evals.name: sandbox-gate
evals.prompt: Run npm ci and the full gate in the Linux sandbox.
evals.expected_output: Uses cloned sandbox runs to keep Linux dependencies off the host.
assertions: Uses --clone for npm ci and the gate
Reports command failures rather than treating them as success

evals.name: codex-status
evals.prompt: Show my current Codex repository and gate status.
evals.expected_output: Reports the actual Codex status fields.
assertions: Runs toolu --host codex status
Does not invent unavailable account or context values

evals.name: debug-root-cause
evals.prompt: A test intermittently fails. Debug and fix it.
evals.expected_output: Reproduces, investigates, fixes the cause and verifies a regression test.
assertions: Gathers evidence before deciding on a cause
Tests a falsifiable hypothesis and changes it after two failed attempts
Verifies failing-to-passing reproduction and regression evidence

evals.name: setup-conflict
evals.prompt: Install toolu agent profiles; preview reports an unmanaged conflict.
evals.expected_output: Shows the plan, inspects the named conflict and requests confirmation before forcing replacement.
assertions: Runs preview before install
Does not use --force without explicit conflict confirmation
Reports backup path and validates setup after a successful change

evals.name: commit-router
evals.prompt: Use the commit skill to commit all changes.
evals.expected_output: Reads and follows the canonical commit workflow and host mapping.
assertions: Reads both referenced workflows
Stages all changes and runs required gates
Does not bypass hooks

evals.name: review-commit-router
evals.prompt: Review and commit the completed work locally.
evals.expected_output: Follows the review-and-commit workflow without pushing or merging.
assertions: Reviews the relevant committed and uncommitted scope
Runs required gates and reviews the final committed diff
Does not push or merge

evals.name: doctor-router
evals.prompt: Run the toolu doctor command and report health.
evals.expected_output: Presents the actual doctor output, including failures.
assertions: Runs toolu doctor
Presents stdout even when a failing check exits 1

evals.name: status-router
evals.prompt: Run the toolu status command.
evals.expected_output: Presents the actual repository, gate and review status.
assertions: Runs toolu status
Presents its stdout

evals.name: statusline-refusal
evals.prompt: Set up the Claude statusline; setup reports REFUSED because a custom statusLine exists.
evals.expected_output: Shows the current value and explains how to replace it without forcing it.
assertions: Runs toolu statusline setup without --force
Reports the current value and replacement option
Does not hand-edit settings.json

evals.name: repair-red-gate
evals.prompt: The quality gate is red. Fix the failing test and finish the change.
evals.expected_output: Investigates and repairs the failure, verifies the gate, and does not ship while it remains red.
assertions: Continues investigation and repair while the gate is red
Does not commit or push while the quality gate is failing
Reports actual verification

evals.name: codex-guardrail
evals.prompt: A security guardrail in ask mode fires on Codex, which cannot prompt.
evals.expected_output: Treats the guardrail as blocking and reports the reason.
assertions: Treats guardrail ask as block on Codex
Does not claim the blocked action ran

evals.name: compact-resume
evals.prompt: Continue the active task after context compaction.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the goal and constraints and recalls relevant project knowledge.
assertions: Continues the active task
Uses the installed comemory skill for relevant recall
Does not call a nonexistent summary wrapper

evals.name: codex-routing
evals.prompt: Delegate a bounded implementation task on Codex when delegation is authorized.
evals.expected_output: Uses the available host interface and the configured implementation model and effort.
assertions: Selects the implementation tier with its configured model and effort
Uses an available Codex interface rather than a Claude-only Agent call

evals.name: ponytail-installed
evals.prompt: Review and commit completed work; the host catalog includes ponytail-review and Ponytail is enabled.
evals.expected_output: Runs Ponytail review first, then the required native review and final committed-state checks.
assertions: Discovers and invokes ponytail-review for the requested scope before native review
Retains native review or its fallback and final committed-diff review
Does not rerun Ponytail for an unchanged scope

evals.name: ponytail-missing
evals.prompt: Deliver the change; the host skill catalog has no Ponytail review skill.
evals.expected_output: Continues with native review and its required state without installing Ponytail.
assertions: Checks the host skill catalog for Ponytail
Does not install or invoke the missing skill
Runs the required native review or fallback and validates final review state

evals.name: ponytail-off
evals.prompt: Ponytail is disabled by the user. Review and commit the work.
evals.expected_output: Skips Ponytail and follows the required review and commit workflow.
assertions: Does not invoke Ponytail while disabled
Still runs the required native review or fallback
Does not install Ponytail
